chunks: In (the shade of) thornless lote trees
ai.seo_question: What does 'sidr makhdood' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'lote tree' (Sidr) is often interpreted as a symbol of divine proximity and the station of the Prophet Muhammad, particularly referencing the Mi'raj. The absence of thorns (Makhduud) signifies the removal of all hardships and distractions, reflecting the perfect ease and spiritual purity of the blessed in Jannah.
